description: This file defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a Vitest configuration specifically for Feishu extensions. It imports external modules for path configurations, pattern loading, and scoped configuration creation, and exports functions related to Vitest setup.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include file patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env if no argument is provided.

methods.name: export function createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig( createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration tailored for the Feishu extension, combining environment-based include patterns with default test roots.
